decision: ACCEPT. Hearth has no address claim, so scopes_supported does not list the address scope. OIDC Core 5.4: the address scope is optional.
ACCEPT. Hearth has no phone claims, so scopes_supported does not list the phone scope. OIDC Core 5.4: the phone scope is optional.
ACCEPT. The module requests the address and phone scopes, which Hearth does not have (see oidcc-scope-address and oidcc-scope-phone).

ACCEPT. The module sends an unsigned (alg none) request object. The spec oidc-provider requires a request object signed with a key from the client's JWKS, so request_object_signing_alg_values_supported does not list none.
ACCEPT. Same reason as oidcc-ensure-request-object-with-redirect-uri: Hearth accepts only signed request objects.
ACCEPT. Same reason as in the Basic OP plan: Hearth accepts only signed request objects.
ACCEPT. Hearth never issues an unsigned (alg none) token. The suite says that this is acceptable for certification.
ACCEPT. Hearth supports the public subject type only (subject_types_supported), not pairwise, so sector_identifier_uri does not apply.
ACCEPT. Same reason as oidcc-registration-sector-uri: no pairwise subject type.
